programme.title: Singh is King
programme.desc: Directed by Anees Bazmee, this action-comedy features Akshay Kumar as Happy Singh, whose journey from a village in Punjab to becoming a crime lord in Australia is filled with humor, action, and unexpected turns.

programme.title: Apna Sapna Money Money
programme.desc: Directed by Sangeeth Sivan, this ensemble comedy follows a colorful cast including a cross-dressing conman, a gangster, and a fake priest all scheming to get rich quick. The film features Suniel Shetty, Ritesh Deshmukh, and Shreyas Talpade, and offers a mix of slapstick humor and mistaken identities.

programme.title: Holiday - A Soldier is Never Off Duty
programme.desc: Directed by A. R. Murugadoss, this action thriller stars Akshay Kumar as Captain Virat Bakshi, who stumbles upon a sleeper cell network during his holiday. Balancing his personal life and duty, he works to prevent a major terrorist attack. The film is a Hindi remake of the Tamil movie Thuppakki.

programme.title: Double Dhamaal
programme.desc: Directed by Indra Kumar, this follow-up to Dhamaal reunites the original gang Ritesh Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi, Aashish Chaudhary, and Javed Jaffrey as they attempt to double-cross a slick businessman (Sanjay Dutt). With new additions Kangana Ranaut and Mallika Sherawat, the film delivers over-the-top antics and comedic twists.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Directed by Abbas Mustan, Race features Saif Ali Khan and Akshaye Khanna as rival brothers in the horse racing business. With twists and turns at every corner, the film delves into themes of greed and betrayal, keeping audiences guessing until the end.
